Beyond the course list

  • Overall GPA At least 2.0 overall GPA.
  • Graduation application Submit the degree completion application within the last semester of the anticipated graduation date.
  • Major course grades At least C in all courses in the major.

Liberty’s transfer rules

  • Up to 45 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 60-credit degree.
  • At least 15 semester credits must be completed at Liberty.

Questions

Does Study.com College Composition I transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com College Composition I for ENGL 101 Composition and Rhetoric (3 semester credits) in the Criminal Justice (A.A.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com Public Speaking transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com Public Speaking for COMS 101 Speech Communication (3 semester credits) in the Criminal Justice (A.A.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com US History I transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com US History I for HIUS 221 Survey of American History I (3 semester credits) in the Criminal Justice (A.A.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Liberty University’s Criminal Justice (A.A.)?

Liberty’s published limit for this 60-credit degree is 45 semester credits from other sources. At least 15 semester credits must be completed at Liberty. This plan proposes 30 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Liberty University?

In this plan, 30 semester credits are taken at Liberty, including RLGN 104 Christian Life and Biblical Worldview, BIBL 104 Survey of Old and New Testament, THEO 104 Introduction to Theology Survey, GOVT 200 Constitutional Government and Free Enterprise, CJUS 231 Criminal Justice Report Writing and CJUS 320 Corrections and 3 more. Liberty requires at least 15 semester credits at Liberty.

Has Liberty University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Liberty’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Ask the school for a written transfer evaluation that confirms these courses for your catalog year, including any major-course residency rules. Ask the school whether your state changes the general-education requirements in this plan. Ask the school to confirm 5 proposed course matches for this exact program before paying for them. Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Liberty’s decisions.
